answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 15756 Country: India Title: Assalamualikum.What is the meaning of RAWAHA.Can i name my son this name? Question: Assalamualikum.What is the meaning of RAWAHA.Can i name my son this name? Answer ID: 15756 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1513/1438=B=1430) Rawahah means pleasure followed by belief and certainty. (Misbahullghat) You can name your son with the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
